WARNING: page 94 has insect bestiality.

The rewards from tarobandit's (a.k.a. Mada Taro / Manadezimon) patreon page (and ONLY the patreon, some images are fragments or covers of some doujin mangas he worked on, or have variants the were not posted on patreon). Note: for language tagging, several images are in English, but several are in ONLY in Japanese. This gallery does not intend to be a comprehensive collection of the artist's works across all platforms, so you won't find the twitter images posted here either. At the time of writing, the artist's Patreon (and fanbox) have not been updated in aproximately 6 months, though IS still active on social media.

Additionally, while several of the reward sequences are uncensored versions of the artist's Pixiv Fanbox rewards, there are several images that never had an uncensored version available on patreon. These were likely to all be Skeb commissions. Skeb is based in Japan, so they're censored by default, and it seems like this artist in particular is one that has a policy of only giving the original/uncensored versions to the commissioner.

The images are organized by release date, with the oldest ones being first in the gallery. The exception are the gif animations, which I've grouped together at the end of the gallery. The last three gifs at the the end were originally a video, not a gif. The first one is a shortened version of the full loop, not missing anything, the sucking portion of the animation is repeated several times without variance. The second one is a loop of the sucking portion only, and the last one is the ejaculation portion only.
